international.title: Cold weather health alerts issued for parts of UK on Sunday night
international.summary: UKHSA warns of threat to vulnerable people from frosty conditions expected to last until Thursday More cold health alerts have been issued for parts of the UK on Sunday night and next week. The alerts were issued by the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) for the north-west, West Midlands and Yorkshire and the Humber, and will be in place from 9pm on Sunday until 9am on Thursday.
